en: Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing the exterior and interior of a traditional half‑timbered building that houses a historic tavern or restaurant. The left panel depicts a steep‑roofed, timber‑framed house with small dormer windows and a signboard reading "Vincentz Richter" above the ground floor, reached by a stone staircase. The right panels show the interior: a rustic dining room with wooden tables and carved chairs, decorated with collections of old weapons such as swords, halberds, rifles and other antique items mounted on the white walls, plus lamps, a bar counter and arched windows.
